headline: South Africa's Mashatile Says R25B World Bank Loan Will Back Structural Reforms
summary: Deputy President Paul Mashatile informed Parliament that South Africa's R25 billion World Bank loan will support structural economic reforms rather than directly financing specific infrastructure projects.
why: World Bank policy loans support South Africa's fiscal position while binding policy to structural market reforms in state enterprises and energy networks.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: The government clarified that R25 billion in multilateral debt will fund structural policy adjustments.
